purpose: SFW nurse role-confirmation reward CG pack
shared_direction: Preserve each adult nurse’s established face, eye color, hair identity and outfit language.
Use a coherent premium visual-novel anime style with crisp line art, detailed cel shading and cinematic hospital lighting.
No text, logo, watermark, blood, incision or exposed patient anatomy. Preoperative ward-care CGs contain no patient at all.

runtime_contract.trigger: First successful assignment of the matching nurse to scrub nurse, circulating nurse, or ward preoperative-care role.

runtime_contract.persistence: Reward IDs are stored in the staff relationship unlocked_benefits list, so the existing save format persists them.
runtime_contract.gallery: All 18 entries appear locked or unlocked in the scrollable Event Memories screen.
